label: Pastillas de leche
note: Sugar and calamansi juice go in; origin San Miguel, Bulacan

about.text: A Filipino milk sweet whose name means milk pills; it is made from carabao or cow milk (or both) with sugar and calamansi juice and comes from San Miguel, Bulacan.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.label: boil down with sugar
how.text: Milk and sugar are cooked together until a stiff paste forms; it is then shaped and rolled in sugar.
